parameters.name: DynamicTagRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the dynamic tag rule.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Start value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Start value: 1. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description:
The tag key.

For more information about how to obtain a tag key, see [DescribeTagKeyList](~~145558~~).

parameters.name: TagRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the tag.

parameters.name: TagValue
parameters.description:
The tag value.

For more information about how to obtain a tag value, see [DescribeTagValueList](~~145557~~).
